0022600096.text: The Magic (0-1) are coming off a loss, sit 4th in the Southeast and 11th in the East, and are 0-1 at home, while the Timberwolves (1-0, with a 1-0 road record) are 2nd in the Northwest and 4th in the West. The Magic won the 2025-26 season series 2-0, including a 132-120 win in Orlando on April 8, and no games have been played yet in the 2026-27 series. Orlando is without Izaiyah Nelson (out, ankle surgery) and Noah Penda (out, hamstring), and Anthony Black (ankle sprain) and Jonathan Isaac (knee) are day-to-day and game-time decisions, while Minnesota is without Donte DiVincenzo (out, Achilles surgery).
